name: bazar-dor
description: Bazar Dor (বাজার দর) – a responsive Next.js app to track daily market prices of essential goods in Bangladesh, with BetterAuth login, protected product pages and category sorting.

paragraphs: A modern, responsive web application built to help users track the daily market prices of essential commodities in Bangladesh.

Bazar Dor shows today's prices of everyday items such as rice, lentils, oil, vegetables, fish and meat, along with how much each price has risen or fallen. Price data is fetched from the Programming Hero Bazar Dor API (
features: Live Price Ticker: A continuous marquee below the navbar displaying the latest prices and trends.
Dynamic Categories & Sorting: Browse products by category with built-in price sorting (default, low to high, high to low) that handles Bengali numerals correctly.
Market Price Comparison: View detailed minimum, maximum, and average prices across different markets in Bangladesh.
Authentication System: Secure email/password login and social logins (Google & GitHub) powered by BetterAuth.
Protected Routes: Product details and user profiles are restricted to authenticated users, with a toast and redirect for visitors who are not signed in.
